cards.title: Second Baby Brain: What New Parents Forget
cards.body: A parent returning to childcare after years away discovers they've forgotten crucial details about feeding, teething, and infant care. Family support helps jog memories while highlighting how much happens in those early years.

cards.title: Should AI Replace Human Parenting Decisions?
cards.body: Tech companies now offer AI-powered parenting tools like eye-movement trackers and nap predictions, raising questions about necessity and effectiveness. Experts debate whether automation actually helps or complicates an already demanding job.

cards.title: The '18 Summers' Parenting Trend Problem
cards.body: Parents increasingly schedule elaborate activities during school holidays to maximize bonding time. Critics argue unstructured summer boredom is actually valuable for children's development.

cards.title: Postpartum Life: Sex, Hormones, and Relationships
cards.body: A couple on the brink of divorce experienced unexpected relationship revival after one partner started hormone replacement therapy. Open communication about changing needs helped rebuild intimacy postbaby.

cards.title: Childbirth Culture Needs to Evolve
cards.body: Healthcare professionals and parents discuss the pressure surrounding 'ideal' birth experiences and recovery expectations. Many report feeling judged or unsupported when births don't follow conventional narratives.

cards.title: Back-to-School: Beyond Supplies and Shopping
cards.body: Parents carry emotional weight beyond logistics when preparing children for school, wanting them to feel they belong. The transition involves managing children's anxiety alongside adult expectations.
